title: BacklogItem
description: One entry of knowledge/backlog.json (the structured successor of TODO.md). An agent should be able to pick the next item by reading only this file: priority, cost, what blocks it, how to know it is done, and where the evidence is.

priority.description: P0 = accuracy of the record is wrong or degrading; P1 = agent leverage; P2 = nice; P3 = someday.

problem.description: Two to five sentences. What is wrong, whom it affects, the measured size.

acceptance.description: A measurable statement, ideally a check or stat reaching a value (e.g. stats.cnn_ambiguous_handles.count == 0).

profile.description: Which profile can do it: cloud, desktop, sandbox, any.

evidence.description: Pointers: checks.json stat names, lesson ids, anomaly kinds, fixture files, file:line.

decision.description: Decision id if one is needed before starting.

phase.description: Migration phase from 10-migration-plan.md, while that plan is being executed; null afterwards.

acceptance_expr.description: Optional machine-evaluable form of acceptance: a comparison of a dotted path in checks.json (or status.json) against a literal, e.g. 'stats.cnn_ambiguous_handles.count == 0' or 'coverage.presumed_live_count < 100'. When present, ts status announces the item as done the run it becomes true.
